column7: Secret create/update/rotate/rollback/delete (folders included) committed first and wrote their secret.* audit row afterwards as a separate append whose failure was only logged (#3276 made it synchronous, not atomic), so a database that accepted the change and refused the row left a secret mutation with no audit record. AUDIT-MUTATION-TX-1 writes the row through the transaction-scoped store as the last statement of the mutation transaction and returns its failure, so the change rolls back. Red-before/green-after: with the append error swallowed every error and effect-then-error case goes red; server/faultops TestSecretMutationAuditFailure_FailsClosedChangesNothing is red on main for all nine REST/gRPC ops (each reported success with its audit row refused).
